// Completeness matrix for asciidoc.imports.scm.
// Each construct below is commented with which target-field variant (or
// negative case) it exercises. `target` is the only node type node-types.json
// lists as a child of `block_macro` for the path (required, exactly one);
// `block_macro_attr` is optional and, when present, holds only the
// bracketed attribute list — never the path.

// --- bare include, no attributes: target present, block_macro_attr absent ---
include::bare.adoc[]

// --- include with a single attribute ---
include::single-attr.adoc[lines=1..10]

// --- include with multiple comma-separated attributes (multiple
// block_macro_attr siblings under one block_macro) ---
include::multi-attr.adoc[lines=1..10,tag=foo]

// --- relative path with parent-directory segments ---
include::../shared/common.adoc[]

// --- path containing a document-attribute reference ({docdir}, {includedir}) ---
include::{includedir}/generated.adoc[]

// --- nested relative path ---
include::sub/nested/deep.adoc[leveloffset=+1]

// ==== NEGATIVE: must NOT be captured as an import ====

// image:: is a block macro but not "include" — must not match @import.
image::diagrams/architecture.png[Architecture]

// A plain paragraph mentioning "include::" as prose text, not at macro
// position (indented so it doesn't parse as a block macro line) — must not
// match.
 This paragraph talks about include::not-a-macro.adoc[] in prose form.
